subject: GreenDock console + API mini-workshop — slot fallback & localized hours
messages:
From: Sam Green <sam.green@greendock.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 2-hr Console + API workshop for GreenDock next week

Hi Olga / Ben,

We'd like to schedule an onboarding mini-workshop for our engineering and product teams to get comfortable with Redwood Console and the API. Goal: console walkthrough (routing, model pinning, rollout policies) + a short API enablement segment (keys, example calls, streaming).

Attendees: ~10 engineers (mix of US/EU).
Duration: ideally 2 hours.
Proposed windows next week (PDT):
- Option A: Tue 10:00–12:00
- Option B: Wed 15:00–17:00

Attached: Greendock_agenda_v2.pdf (draft) and access-worksheet.xlsx (who needs what). Please let us know which slot works or suggest alternatives. We prefer hands-on if possible; will need sandbox creds and a short pre-provision checklist.

Thanks,
Sam Green
Head of Platform
GreenDock

Attachments: Greendock_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF), access-worksheet.xlsx (Excel)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@greendock.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-hr Console + API workshop for GreenDock next week

Hi Sam — thanks for the agenda and worksheet.

Quick note: for groups spanning US and EU it's often more effective to split into two 60-minute sessions — one focused on Console operations and rollout, and a second for API enablement + hands-on lab. That reduces context switching and lets engineers try the calls in a sandbox with our guidance.

Do you have a list of participants by timezone? If so we can propose a split that maximizes overlap. Also: for the hands-on lab we'll need one person per attendee to have a temporary development key and the sandbox provisioned 24 hours prior. I attached a short runbook (runbook-olga-v1.pdf) that outlines the pre-provision steps and participant instructions.

Options I can offer this week (PDT):
- Split: Tue 10:00–11:00 (Console) + Wed 10:00–11:00 (API lab)
- Compressed: Wed 15:00–16:00 (Console) + Wed 16:00–17:00 (API lab)

If neither works, we can look at early-morning US / late-evening EU overlaps. Let me know preference and I'll coordinate calendar invites and the sandbox prep.

Cheers,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Attachment: runbook-olga-v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-29 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 2-hr Console + API workshop for GreenDock next week

Thanks Sam / Olga.

Agree with Olga that splitting will help. GreenDock mentioned APAC folks in the attendee list during the discovery call — to cover that, I'm proposing we do two 60-minute blocks separated by a day so we can accommodate an APAC-friendly hour if needed. Example schedule:

- Block 1 (Console deep-dive): Tue 08:00–09:00 PDT — US morning, EU afternoon
- Block 2 (API hands-on + Q&A): Thu 16:00–17:00 PDT — US late afternoon, APAC overlap

Jordan, can you lead the hands-on lab for Block 2? I'll handle the Console deep-dive and the rollout questions.

Ben
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
